name: City St George's, University of London
summary: About 80 bachelor’s degrees on two London campuses: Clerkenwell for subjects such as journalism, Tooting for medicine and medical training.

ib.text: Each course sets its own IB offer, from 31 points with SL English 5 and SL Maths 4 (Journalism) to 36 with 18 at HL, including 6 in Biology and Chemistry (Medicine).

dates.label: UCAS equal consideration deadline (all other courses), 18:00 UK time

programmes.name: Medicine MBBS
programmes.about: A five-year clinically focused degree on the Tooting campus, taught with students of other healthcare professions, with practicals in pathology labs and an anatomy suite, and placements from GP to psychiatry and radiology.
programmes.ib: 36 points with 18 at HL, including 6 in Biology and Chemistry; at SL, 5 in Maths and English.
programmes.selectionNote: UCAT needs at least 500 in every section plus a yearly overall cut-off; the SJT band counts. Shortlisted applicants sit multiple mini interviews.

flagshipSource.title: Medicine MBBS: taught alongside other healthcare students, beside St George's Hospital (course page)

programmes.name: Journalism
programmes.about: Multimedia journalism with a real-world emphasis: small workshops in reporting and writing, shorthand and photography, electives in English, Sociology, Politics or Creative Writing, and professional work experience.
programmes.ib: 31 points, with at least 5 in SL English and 4 in SL Maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers follow the IB points; applicants predicted lower but with journalism experience may be considered for interview.

flagshipSource.title: Journalism: real-world workshops, with work experience at outlets such as Sky News and The Times (course page)

programmes.name: Optometry
programmes.about: Four years to train as a registered optometrist: optics, biology, eye disease and lenses, with clinical practice in the University's own eye clinic, City Sight, and 44 weeks of clinical placements, including one at Moorfields.
programmes.ib: 33 points including 6 in two HL sciences, and at SL 5 in English and 4 in Maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers follow the IB points and subject grades; the course page lists no interview or test.

flagshipSource.title: Optometry MOptom: its own eye clinic, City Sight, and 44 weeks of clinical placements (course page)

notes: EU students pay the international fee for 2027/28: £47,380 for Medicine, £23,010 for Journalism and £20,190 for Optometry.
Medicine ranks overseas applicants separately from home applicants and asks for at least 500 in every UCAT section.
Where you study depends on the course: check whether its page says Clerkenwell or Tooting campus before you apply.
